items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: They had Andrew Morgan, they had Cap, Homer Eugene, and I just remember, they had two men, about four or five, and they were recording or doing something.

ctx.x: They had Andrew Morgan, they had Cap, Homer Eugene, and I just remember, they had two men, about four or five, and they were recording or doing something. It wasn't for long, it was just something that he wanted did, you know, that they wanted did, and it wasn't long because I brought Cap up there because Cap didn't know, you know, the city, he didn't know how to get up there, it was, and so we went up there. Tell me what that was. It must have been before my time. That was during your time because you had...…
